title: The Role and Use of Mathematical Programming in Agricultural, Natural Resource, and Climate Change Analysis
abstract: Climate change undeniably impacts agriculture and natural resources, enterprises and markets. For informed decision making, there is a need for information on climate change adaptation possibilities and mitigation alternatives. Mathematical programming has been used to address the economic aspects of such questions and allows analysis as climate change moves the environment into previously unobserved conditions. It allows us to model spatial and dynamic features of the issue and analyze heretofore unobserved adaptation and mitigation possibilities. This review provides an overview of and references for modeling techniques, conceptual issues, and major assumptions involved with using mathematical programming as a climate change economic analyzing engine, along with a brief comparison with other methods. We also review a number of studies applying mathematical programming to examine climate change impacts, adaptation, and mitigation issues in the agricultural and natural resources arena. Finally, we present a very brief discussion on research needs.
abstract_zh: 气候变化无疑影响着农业和自然资源、企业及市场。为进行知情决策，我们需要有关气候变化适应可能性和减缓替代方案的信息。数学规划已被用于解决此类问题的经济层面，并使分析能够应对气候变化将环境推入此前未观测到的状态的情形。它使我们能够对该问题的空间和动态特征进行建模，并分析此前未被观测到的适应和减缓可能性。本综述概述了将数学规划用作气候变化经济分析工具所涉及的建模技术、概念问题和主要假设，并提供了相关文献，同时简要比较了其他方法。我们还回顾了一些将数学规划应用于农业和自然资源领域、考察气候变化影响、适应和减缓问题的研究。最后，我们简要讨论了未来的研究需求。

title: Climate Change and Livestock Production: A Literature Review
abstract: Globally, the climate is changing, and this has implications for livestock. Climate affects livestock growth rates, milk and egg production, reproductive performance, morbidity, and mortality, along with feed supply. Simultaneously, livestock is a climate change driver, generating 14.5% of total anthropogenic Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions. Herein, we review the literature addressing climate change and livestock, covering impacts, emissions, adaptation possibilities, and mitigation strategies. While the existing literature principally focuses on ruminants, we extended the scope to include non-ruminants. We found that livestock are affected by climate change and do enhance climate change through emissions but that there are adaptation and mitigation actions that can limit the effects of climate change. We also suggest some research directions and especially find the need for work in developing country settings. In the context of climate change, adaptation measures are pivotal to sustaining the growing demand for livestock products, but often their relevance depends on local conditions. Furthermore, mitigation is key to limiting the future extent of climate change and there are a number of possible strategies.
abstract_zh: 全球气候正在变化，这对畜牧业产生了影响。气候影响家畜的生长速度、奶和蛋的产量、繁殖性能、发病率和死亡率，以及饲料供应。同时，畜牧业也是气候变化的驱动因素，占人为温室气体排放总量的14.5%。在此，我们回顾了关于气候变化与畜牧业的文献，涵盖影响、排放、适应可能性和减缓策略。虽然现有文献主要关注反刍动物，但我们将范围扩展到了非反刍动物。我们发现，畜牧业受到气候变化的影响，并且也会通过排放加剧气候变化，但存在一些适应和减缓行动可以限制气候变化的影响。我们还提出了一些研究方向，并特别指出需要在发展中国家开展相关工作。在气候变化背景下，适应措施对于维持日益增长的畜产品需求至关重要，但其相关性往往取决于当地条件。此外，减缓是限制未来气候变化程度的关键，并存在若干可能的策略。

title: A comparative evaluation of the performance of CHIRPS and CFSR data for different climate zones using the SWAT model
abstract: The spatial and temporal scale of rainfall datasets is crucial in modeling hydrological processes. Recently, open-access satellite precipitation products with improved resolution have evolved as a potential alternative to sparsely distributed ground-based observations, which sometimes fail to capture the spatial variability of rainfall. However, the reliability and accuracy of the satellite precipitation products in simulating streamflow need to be verified. In this context, the objective of the current study is to assess the performance of three rainfall datasets in the prediction of daily and monthly streamflow using Soil and Water Assessment Tool (SWAT). We used rainfall data from three different sources: Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Rainfall with Station data (CHIRPS), Climate Forecast System Reanalysis (CFSR) and observed rain gauge data. Daily and monthly rainfall measurements from CHIRPS and CFSR were validated using widely accepted statistical measures, namely, correlation coefficient (CC), root mean squared error (RMSE), probability of detection (POD), false alarm ratio (FAR), and critical success index (CSI). The results showed that CHIRPS was in better agreement with ground-based rainfall at daily and monthly scale, with high rainfall detection ability, in comparison with the CFSR product. Streamflow prediction across multiple watersheds was also evaluated using Kling-Gupta Efficiency (KGE), Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) and Percent BIAS (PBIAS). Irrespective of the climatic characteristics, the hydrologic simulations of CHIRPS showed better agreement with the observed at the monthly scale with the majority of the NSE values ranging between 0.40 and 0.78, and KGE values ranging between 0.62 and 0.82. Overall, CHIRPS outperformed the CFSR rainfall product in driving SWAT for streamflow simulations across the multiple watersheds selected for the study. The results from the current study demonstrate the potential of CHIRPS as an alternate open access rainfall input to the hydrologic model.
abstract_zh: 降雨数据集的空间和时间尺度对模拟水文过程至关重要。近来，分辨率不断提高的开放获取卫星降水产品已发展成为稀疏分布的地面观测（有时无法捕捉降雨的空间变异性）的一种潜在替代。然而，卫星降水产品在模拟河川径流方面的可靠性和准确性仍需验证。在此背景下，本研究旨在利用土壤和水评估工具（SWAT）评估三种降雨数据集在预测日尺度和月尺度河川径流方面的表现。我们使用了三种不同来源的降雨数据：气候灾害组红外降雨站点数据（CHIRPS）、气候预报系统再分析数据（CFSR）以及观测雨量计数据。我们使用广泛接受的统计指标——相关系数（CC）、均方根误差（RMSE）、探测概率（POD）、误报率（FAR）和临界成功指数（CSI）——对CHIRPS和CFSR的日尺度与月尺度降雨测量进行了验证。结果表明，与CFSR产品相比，CHIRPS在日尺度和月尺度上与地面降雨的吻合度更好，且具有较高的降雨探测能力。我们还利用Kling-Gupta效率（KGE）、Nash-Sutcliffe效率（NSE）和百分比偏差（PBIAS）评估了多个流域的河川径流模拟。无论气候特征如何，CHIRPS驱动的水文模拟在月尺度上与观测值吻合得更好，大多数NSE值介于0.40至0.78之间，KGE值介于0.62至0.82之间。总体而言，在本研究选取的多个流域中，CHIRPS驱动SWAT进行河川径流模拟的表现优于CFSR降雨产品。本研究结果表明，CHIRPS有潜力作为一种替代性的开放获取降雨输入，用于水文模型。

title: Identifying Vulnerable Households Using Machine Learning
Adaptation in Agriculture
venue: Climate Resilient Agriculture-Strategies and Perspectives, book chapter
abstract: Climate Change is continuing and happening faster than previously anticipated. Agriculture is vulnerable on a global scale and is currently adapting but will need to make further efforts in the future. Both public and private adaptation actions will need to occur, as certain potentially desirable adaptations are either not feasible or cost effective for private parties. Public action will play a crucial role in facilitating and supporting farmers to overcome barriers to adaptation and move toward a more sustainable and resilient agriculture. Here we discuss the sensitivity of agriculture to climate change and the adaptation strategies observed or potentially possible. We also discuss private and public roles in adaptation along with the constraints and barriers that limit adaptation. In addition, we discuss desirable factors to consider in adaptation project appraisal.
abstract_zh: 气候变化仍在持续，且发生速度比此前预期的更快。农业在全球范围内十分脆弱，目前正在进行适应，但未来还需做出更多努力。公共和私人层面的适应行动都将是必要的，因为某些潜在可取的适应措施对于私人主体而言要么不可行，要么不具有成本效益。公共行动将在促进和支持农民克服适应障碍、迈向更可持续和更具韧性的农业方面发挥关键作用。在此，我们讨论了农业对气候变化的敏感性以及已观察到或可能实现的适应策略。我们还讨论了公共和私人在适应中的作用，以及限制适应的约束和障碍。此外，我们讨论了在适应项目评估中值得考虑的有益因素。

title: How does climate change affect agriculture
venue: Routledge Handbook of Agricultural Economics, book chapter
abstract: Agriculture is highly dependent on the climate and is thus very vulnerable to climate change. However, the nature of total climate change effect is broader than just alterations in production and costs ( vulnerability ); it also extends to adaptation actions undertaken in response to the changed climate and mitigation actions undertaken to reduce drivers of further climate change. Hence, areas for economic research on climate change issue involves looking at three issues: (1) vulnerability, (2) adaption, and (3) mitigation. Research in and across these areas is important for understanding the future of agricultural production and markets along with formulating investments or policy initiatives to maintain/increase availability of low-cost commodities. In this chapter, we address these three aspects of the climate change issue in an agricultural economy context and the ways economists have approached these aspects. We do this by providing supporting literature reviews of climate change effects on agriculture, along with reviews of work on agricultural adaptation and mitigation actions. Agricultural economics work in these arenas is quite important in guiding investment patterns and policies along with understanding future market conditions. JEL classification: Q54
abstract_zh: 农业高度依赖气候，因而对气候变化十分脆弱。然而，气候变化的总体影响范围不仅限于产量和成本的改变（脆弱性），还延伸至为应对气候变化而采取的适应行动，以及为减少进一步气候变化驱动因素而采取的减缓行动。因此，关于气候变化问题的经济学研究领域涉及三个方面：（1）脆弱性，（2）适应，以及（3）减缓。在这些领域内及其之间开展研究，对于理解农业生产和市场的未来，以及制定投资或政策举措以维持或提高低成本农产品的供应，都十分重要。在本章中，我们从农业经济的角度探讨气候变化问题的这三个方面，以及经济学家处理这些方面的方式。我们通过梳理气候变化对农业影响的相关文献，以及农业适应和减缓行动的研究，来进行论述。农业经济学在这些领域的工作，对于引导投资模式和政策制定，以及理解未来市场条件，都具有十分重要的意义。JEL分类：Q54

title: Adaptation: An agricultural challenge
abstract: Agriculture is quite sensitive to climate change and to date it has been impacted in many ways. In turn, adaptation to lessen the impacts has attracted increasing attention. Here we discuss private and public roles in adaptation, as well as procedures for the evaluation of adaptation projects. Additionally, we discuss adaptation realities and limits that constrain the practical ability of adaptation actions to cope with climate effects.
abstract_zh: 农业对气候变化十分敏感，迄今为止已在多方面受到影响。与此相应，为减轻这些影响而进行的适应备受关注。本文讨论了公共部门和私人部门在适应中的作用，以及适应项目的评估程序。此外，我们还讨论了适应的现实条件与局限，这些条件与局限制约着适应行动应对气候影响的实际能力。

title: Estimating the Impacts of Climate Change and Potential Adaptation Strategies on Cereal Grains in the United States
abstract: Climate change induced alterations from historical patterns of precipitation, temperature, and atmospheric gases as well as increases in the frequency of extreme events is leading to alterations in global cereal production and its spatial distribution. Using a US agricultural sector model, we examine effects and acreage adaptation with an emphasis on wheat and the Pacific Northwest region. Use of a national sector model allows for analysis at the national as well as regional level. Generally, under climate change we find that the incidence of wheat production shifts northward in the Southern Great Plains, westward in Northern Great Plains and eastward in Oregon and Washington, all of which are moves to cooler conditions. Total wheat acreage in the Pacific Northwest is expected to decline from 6 million acres under no climate change to 5.4-5.7 million acres over the study period. Additionally, we consider impacts on price, production, and consumer, producer, and foreign welfare finding losses to consumer welfare and gains to producer welfare with overall losses in surplus. Recommendations are made for future research and alternative ways that adaptation strategies can be integrated into models to predict long-term impacts.
abstract_zh: 气候变化引起的降水、温度和大气气体相对于历史模式的变化，以及极端事件频率的增加，正在导致全球谷物产量及其空间分布的改变。我们使用一个美国农业部门模型，考察了以小麦和太平洋西北地区为重点的效应和种植面积适应情况。全国性部门模型的使用，使我们能够在全国和区域两个层面进行分析。总体而言，在气候变化情景下，我们发现小麦生产的分布会向北移动：南部大平原向北、北部大平原向西，俄勒冈州和华盛顿州则向东，这些移动均指向更凉爽的条件。在太平洋西北地区，小麦总种植面积预计将从无气候变化情景下的600万英亩下降至研究期间的540万至570万英亩。此外，我们还考察了对价格、产量以及消费者、生产者和外国福利的影响，发现消费者福利受损，生产者福利增加，总体剩余减少。文中为未来研究以及将适应策略纳入模型以预测长期影响的替代方式提出了建议。
